timeline.summary: On May 14, 2026, Hi-Tech Pipes filed the monitoring agency report showing Rs 440.00 million of unutilized QIP proceeds parked in fixed deposits as of March 31, 2026.
Ajay Kumar Bansal (Promoter) declared no new encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of April 4, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,480.36 Cr (+101.8% YoY), net profit ₹17.6 Cr (-0.2% YoY).
Hi-Tech Pipes Limited shared the audio recording link of its **Q4FY26 & FY26 earnings conference call** held on May 28, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST, signed by **Arun Kumar**, MD.
Hi-Tech Pipes filed its statement of deviation or variation for fund utilisation for Q4FY26 showing zero deviation.
On May 28, 2026, Hi-Tech Pipes reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,480 Cr, up 102% YoY, and guided for FY27 volume of 6.5 to 7 lakh tons.
On October 17, 2026, Hi-Tech Pipes informed the exchange that CRISIL reaffirmed its credit ratings at A+/Stable and A1, enhancing total rated bank facilities to ₹565 crore.
